episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.summary: After a hurricane, John B, JJ, Pope and Kiara plunge headlong into danger and adventure when they find a mysterious sunken wreck.

episodes.title: The Lucky Compass
episodes.summary: Convinced that the clue found onboard the boat connects to his missing father, John B leads his friends on an increasingly frantic search for answers.

episodes.title: The Forbidden Zone
episodes.summary: As the gang hatches an illicit scheme to get to the bottom of the deep-sea mystery, John B confronts Sarah while Pope jumps at the chance for revenge.

episodes.title: Spy Games
episodes.summary: When John B's supervision-free home life catches up to him, he receives a well-timed assist — and some spiffing up — from the last person he expects.

episodes.title: Midsummers
episodes.summary: John B believes he's made a breakthrough in the hunt for the gold, but his desire to include Sarah in the quest causes friction among the friends.

episodes.title: Parcel 9
episodes.summary: A spooky island legend, a broken friendship and John B's new living situation keep the crew on their toes as they search high and low for the treasure.

episodes.title: Dead Calm
episodes.summary: JJ's reckless behavior ramps up when the friends try to score some quick cash. Meanwhile, John B grows closer to Sarah — and makes her dad suspicious.

episodes.title: The Runway
episodes.summary: John B finally learns the truth about his dad — and sets off a chain of events that jeopardizes everything he and his friends have fought to accomplish.

episodes.title: The Bell Tower
episodes.summary: With his options dwindling and enemies closing in, John B looks for an exit plan. Sarah feels pressured to pick a side. Pope lets his emotions out.

episodes.title: The Phantom
episodes.summary: An island crawling with law enforcement and a looming tropical storm are just two of the obstacles facing John B as he tries to make his escape.

episodes.title: The Gold
episodes.summary: John B tries to evade capture as he zeroes in on the gold, but a promise to Sarah could derail his plans. Back home, his friends face life without him.

episodes.title: The Heist
episodes.summary: With time running out, John B and Sarah strike an uneasy bargain, while Kiara, JJ and Pope search for evidence that could implicate Ward and Rafe.

episodes.title: Prayers
episodes.summary: A desperate scramble for help lands John B and Sarah in questionable surroundings. Pope receives a mysterious summons to an out-of-town meeting.

episodes.title: Homecoming
episodes.summary: Low on gas and strapped for cash, John B and Sarah run into trouble. Pope's appointment in Charleston takes an ominous turn over a proposed trade.

episodes.title: The Darkest Hour
episodes.summary: JJ cooks up a risky plan to help out John B. Pope hunts down information about the key. Kiara and Sarah both deal with family fallout over the Pogues.

episodes.title: My Druthers
episodes.summary: John B bristles when Sarah reconnects with a former flame. Ward's web of lies starts to unravel. Pope discovers a shocking family secret.

episodes.title: The Bonfire
episodes.summary: Reeling from Ward's actions, Sarah finds her loyalties to John B and the Pogues put to the test. At the annual bonfire, jealousies and tempers flare.

episodes.title: The Cross
episodes.summary: Armed with new clues, the group braves perilous roads and swampland as they race to keep part of Pope's history from falling into the wrong hands.

episodes.title: Trapped
episodes.summary: The Pogues deal with a slew of setbacks — a medical emergency, a nosy neighbor, parental ultimatums — as they attempt to save Pope's family legacy.

episodes.title: The Coastal Venture
episodes.summary: John B, Pope, JJ and Kiara brace for a showdown on board the ship, while Sarah realizes the harsh truth of her distressing family situation.

episodes.title: Poguelandia
episodes.summary: An unexpected rescuer takes the Pogues from a remote island to Barbados, where they encounter a powerful treasure hunter with his own agenda.

episodes.title: The Bells
episodes.summary: As her friends mount a rescue attempt, Kiara agrees to an uneasy truce with Rafe. A familiar sound grabs John B's attention.

episodes.title: Fathers and Sons
episodes.summary: Big John and John B pick up where they left off — for better or worse. Cleo and Pope form a new club. Rafe reconnects with Ward.

episodes.title: The Diary
episodes.summary: An emotional homecoming is easier for some than others. Big John searches for the diary. Ward's plans for a prized possession don't sit well with Rafe.

episodes.title: Heists
episodes.summary: Sarah convinces an old friend to help with a high-risk, high-reward mission. Looking to access a museum collection, John B and his dad get creative.

episodes.title: The Dark Forest
episodes.summary: Secrets threaten to drive a wedge between John B and his friends. Sarah revisits a past life. Pope reaches a breaking point.

episodes.title: Happy Anniversary
episodes.summary: With Singh on the move, John B and JJ scramble to catch him. Pope makes a breakthrough. Sarah questions where her loyalties lie.

episodes.title: Tapping the Rudder
episodes.summary: Rafe lays his cards on the table and Sarah calls in two favors. JJ's unorthodox plan to get to South America lands John B in hot water.

episodes.title: Welcome to Kitty Hawk
episodes.summary: With their ride to Orinoco waiting on the tarmac, Kiara and JJ run into several complications. Rafe has a change of heart.

episodes.title: Secret of the Gnomon
episodes.summary: The Pogues' search for El Dorado brings them deep into the jungle, where John B and Sarah face the ultimate test of their courage and family bonds.

episodes.title: The Enduro
episodes.summary: Flush with success, the Pogues have big plans to invest in their future. But when their fortunes take a turn, will a bold gamble pay off?

episodes.title: Blackbeard
episodes.summary: A strange tale of a family curse makes the Pogues think twice about accepting a lucrative offer to search for an amulet linked to Blackbeard.

episodes.title: The Lupine Corsairs
episodes.summary: The sheriff grills the Pogues about their dealings with Wes Genrette. JJ and Kiara have another close call. Pope gets wind of a mysterious artifact.

episodes.title: The Swell
episodes.summary: Tensions rise along with the waves when the Pogues and the Kooks hit the beach for the year's best swell. As Pope digs for info, Cleo faces down danger.

episodes.title: Albatross
episodes.summary: The Pogues scramble when the sheriff turns up at the worst possible time. JJ receives a mysterious letter. The amulet's clues point to Charleston.

episodes.title: The Town Council
episodes.summary: JJ learns about his past. The Pogues rally support for a zoning meeting that will decide their fate. Sarah and John B suss out a theory about the scroll.

episodes.title: Mothers and Fathers
episodes.summary: As a confrontation on Goat Island turns perilous, Sarah confirms a suspicion while searching for JJ, Pope's future falters, and Topper taunts John B.

episodes.title: Family Plot
episodes.summary: While JJ heads out on a grim mission with Groff, Sarah reveals her big news, Pope faces a moment of truth, and Rafe helps the sheriff connect the dots.

episodes.title: The Storm
episodes.summary: Pursued by police, the Pogues embark on the next stage of their mission with help from an unexpected source. Tensions flare when John B confides in JJ.

episodes.title: The Blue Crown
episodes.summary: The hunt for Groff heats up in Morocco. In a deadly race to claim the crown, loyalties are tested — and a moment of treachery changes everything.

episodes.title: The Crossing
episodes.summary: Devastated by a loss and stranded in Morocco, the Pogues navigate a treacherous border crossing as they race to intercept Groff — and the Blue Crown.

episodes.title: The Crown
episodes.summary: With her quest for vengeance hanging in the balance, Kiara strikes an uneasy deal with a rival. Groff's scheme to get rich goes sideways in Dubrovnik.

episodes.title: The Square Grouper
episodes.summary: The crew hits rock bottom with a hostile homecoming to the OBX, but the tide begins to turn when John B snags a lucrative catch.

episodes.title: Inside Job
episodes.summary: With Sarah's life at stake, Rafe runs interference at a Kook golf tournament while John B attempts a brazen heist in the heart of Figure 8.

episodes.title: The Scytale
episodes.summary: Kiara and Pope search for a mysterious artifact that could unlock the Blue Crown's powers. Rafe faces mounting pressure to sell Tannyhill to developers.

episodes.title: The Big Easy
episodes.summary: Sarah and John B hit the road to pursue a fresh lead in New Orleans, where Sarah comes face-to-face with a figure from her past.

episodes.title: Bal des Sauvages
episodes.summary: The Pogues infiltrate a glitzy masquerade party, where Kiara angles for access to the scytale drawings — and crosses paths with a murderous enemy.

episodes.title: The Runway Part 2
episodes.summary: The friends get crafty to decode the scytale's secrets. Rafe becomes a wanted man when a violent mistake catches up to him. Cleo makes an explosive move.

episodes.title: Arise, Arise
episodes.summary: A mission to Azerbaijan gets rocky when Pope engineers a daring ambush. Kiara rushes to outpace the Corsairs and test the Crown's powers of resurrection.

episodes.title: The Storm and What Came After
episodes.summary: As a raging hurricane lashes Kildare, the Pogues race to save their loved ones and settle the score before a life-changing treasure slips away — again.
